statement: Every small service shop runs its admin from one phone, so its owners spend their time on customers
end_state: Small service shops in the US no longer need a back office or a stack of separate tools for bookings, stock and payroll

measures.statement: Admin hours an owner saves each week

owner_outcome.why: Vertical software buyers consolidate small-business tools; the founders and seed investors expect a sale within ten years

exit_criteria.statement: 40 percent of shops that start are still active after three months
Owners report saving at least two hours a week
Hair and beauty shops in three states adopt without founder-led sales
Customer acquisition cost paid back within 12 months
